opening.argument: The title presents Forsage as an opportunity to earn money, and the description makes the recruitment link explicit: it offers payment per referral, advertises “Unlimited” earning, and asks for 20 networkers. Those are concrete solicitation terms, not merely commentary about finance. The spoken line about taking a risk is consistent with that earning pitch, but the case does not depend on treating it as proof of an outcome. Taken together, the title and description frame earning as dependent on bringing in other participants, establishing a recruitment-based solicitation. This supports the position that the content promotes a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scheme; it does not establish actual losses or completed recruitment.
